import urllib.request
import urllib.parse
# Find an alternative source via Unpaywall API with email param
url = 'https://api.unpaywall.org/v2/10.1016%2Fj.neuron.2012.08.041?email=a.nikolaev@sheffield.ac.uk'
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
        data = r.read().decode('utf-8')
        import json
        d = json.loads(data)
        oa = d.get('best_oa_location', {})
        print(f'Best OA URL: {oa.get("url") if oa else None}')
        print(f'PDF URL: {oa.get("url_for_pdf") if oa else None}')
        # Also list other locations
        for loc in d.get('oa_locations', []):
            print(f'  - {loc.get("host_type")}: pdf={loc.get("url_for_pdf")} landing={loc.get("url_for_landing_page")}')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'Error: {e}')
